text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Нарита Брайан out in a
field pulling
weeds with the
groundskeeper.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is such a pain! How much more do
we have to
do?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Punishment. She walked through the
field and
trampled the seedlings, so I'm
having her pull
weeds.
text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper

text_block_list.text:
I said I didn't mean to, didn't I?! Damn!
It's really
not my day!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Fine! I'll make this into a field of despair!
Get
ready, weeds!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан pulls weeds savagely, but
stooping
over all day pulling weeds must
be tiring, even for
her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
